<a id="tracebus"></a>

## `TraceBus`

static class · `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Bus.TraceBus` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core`

In-process, Unity-free publish channel that feeds the diagnostic stream. Producers (event bus, data bus, textures, voice, mods) call [`TraceBus.Emit`](#tracebus--emit-string-string).

Two kinds of reader. The trace file's consumer [`TraceBus.Attach`](#tracebus--attach)es: there is one of it, and events emitted before it attaches are buffered up to [`TraceBus.BufferCapacity`](#tracebus--buffercapacity) (oldest dropped, counted in [`TraceBus.Dropped`](#tracebus--dropped)) and replayed carrying their original [`BusEvent.Time`](#busevent--time). Everything else [`TraceBus.Subscribe`](#tracebus--subscribe)s: any number of observers, each of which sees every event. The second kind exists so the console sink can print on the calling thread, in event order, while the file copy stays on the writer thread.

Never throws into a producer.

<a id="tracebus--buffercapacity"></a>

### `const int BufferCapacity = 2000`

Maximum events held while no consumer is attached.

<a id="tracebus--dropped"></a>

### `static long Dropped { get; }`

<a id="tracebus--emitted"></a>

### `static long Emitted { get; }`

<a id="tracebus--hasconsumer"></a>

### `static bool HasConsumer { get; }`

True when a consumer is attached.

<a id="tracebus--observers"></a>

### `static int Observers { get; }`

How many observers are subscribed (the console sink is one of them).

<a id="tracebus--attach"></a>

### `static IDisposable Attach(Action<BusEvent> consumer)`

Attach the single consumer. Buffered events are delivered first, in order, on the caller's thread. A later Attach replaces the consumer. Dispose the result to detach (events buffer again).

<a id="tracebus--reset"></a>

### `static void Reset()`

Test/dev helper: forget the consumer, the observers and buffered events; counters reset.

<a id="tracebus--seterrorsink"></a>

### `static void SetErrorSink(Action<Exception> sink)`

Where consumer exceptions are reported (the Trace plugin wires this to its logger). Null = swallowed.

<a id="tracebus--subscribe"></a>

### `static IDisposable Subscribe(Action<BusEvent> observer)`

Adds an observer that sees every event from now on, plus whatever is still in the pre-attach buffer (each buffered event carries its ORIGINAL [`BusEvent.Time`](#busevent--time), so a replayed line is stamped when it happened, not when it was replayed). Dispose the result to stop observing.

**Parameters**

- `observer`: Called on the publishing thread. Must not block and must not throw.

**Returns:** A handle that removes the observer.

**Exceptions**

- `ArgumentNullException`: `observer` is null.
